text:
Jules (CSM): Quick heads up — CustomerCorp wants to restructure ahead of their renewal. They want to reduce from 45 seats -> 30 and switch billing to their EU subsidiary. Procurement says PO will change. Need path for amendment + signer + invoice so service doesn't get interrupted.
Kara (AM): Do we have a standard amendment for billing-entity swap? I remember Legal had a template but not sure about delegated signer flow.
Marta (Legal): We do have a template but billing-entity swaps require: new EIN, delegated-signer attestation, and a countersigned amendment. If they can do DocuSign, turnaround is usually ~48–72 hours. If they need wet signature it will add days.
Devon (Finance): For billing we need vendor-code update before we can route invoices to the new entity. AP will accept a PO in the interim if it's for the new entity. If not, they can pay by CC while we process vendor update. Which does customer prefer?
Jules (CSM): Procurement said they prefer not to use CC. They expect procurement approval in 2–3 business days and then new PO. They asked if we can hold invoice until PO is in place.
Devon (Finance): Holding invoice is okay but we need an internal AP ticket to switch vendor code and update billing entity on the contract. I'll open it now.
Kara (AM): @Devon please confirm if any pricing change occurs due to seat count drop. Is prorate automatic?
Devon (Finance): Seat decrease at renewal => we prorate unused portion per our billing rules. No pricing increase. I'll confirm exact credit amount once the PO number and dates are finalized.
Marta (Legal): Action items from legal side: 1) draft amendment w/ new billing entity + seat count, 2) gather EIN and delegated signer doc, 3) send DocuSign envelope. I can produce redline today if they provide EIN.
Jules (CSM): I'll ask CustomerCorp for EIN + delegated signer doc right now. Also confirm whether procurement will give us the new PO number before renewal date.
patrick-ops: FYI ops — if seat count drops below 40 it may affect dedicated capacity reservation. We should not change capacity until billing & contract signed.
Jules (CSM): Noted. ops will remain as-is until amendment countersigned.
CustomerCorp Procurement: We can get EIN + signed delegation by EOD tomorrow. PO will be issued after approval, expected within 48 hours of that. We will not use CC.
Jules (CSM): Great — @Marta I'll send EIN and delegation to you once they come in.
Marta (Legal): Got it. I'll queue amendment draft and prepare DocuSign. If they need any special tax clause for EU entity let me know.
Devon (Finance): Creating AP ticket for vendor code change now. Patch:```
AP ticket: vendor-code-update
Customer: CustomerCorp EU Subsidiary
Reason: Billing entity swap for renewal
Requested by: Devon
Priority: High
```
ap-bot: AP ticket #82745 created and assigned to AP queue.
Kara (AM): Thanks. I'll track procurement and update the renewal timeline in CRM. Plan: get docs -> legal sends DocuSign -> countersign -> AP updates vendor code -> invoice issued to new entity. Target: invoice by next Monday if docs arrive today.
Jules (CSM): Looping in: @patrick-ops and @Devon — if any blocker surfaces I'll escalate to Kara. Customer said they'll send docs EOD.
CustomerCorp Procurement: Sending EIN + delegation to procurement@redwood.com now. Please confirm receipt.
Jules (CSM): Received. Forwarded to Legal. Marta, you should have the files.
Marta (Legal): Received and uploaded. Sending DocuSign in ~1 hour.
Devon (Finance): Vendor code ticket updated #82745 -> awaiting AP confirmation.
Jules (CSM): I'll keep this thread updated. If anything slips, we escalate to legal lead + finance manager. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
